calls.title: GrowthBook <> Brightscout | Dev Session
calls.summary: The team convened to discuss key initiatives aimed at enhancing website functionality and aesthetics, including the standardization of HubSpot form integrations to ensure consistent styling across pages, which will allow for easier reuse and reduce development effort. They also agreed to move the CMS migration timeline earlier to facilitate content refreshes led by Tiffany and ensure thorough design checks. A cross-page QA and URL finalization are scheduled for early March to allow SEO checks and prevent rushed changes. Additionally, the gradient stripe animation was simplified for timely delivery, while the marketing team will utilize pre-built components for rapid page creation, with developer support available for legal pages. Continuous SEO agency reviews will be conducted to maintain best practices during the content delivery process, ensuring effective meta title management for both dynamic and static pages.
calls.keywords: HubSpot integration, CMS migration, URL finalization, SEO meta review, Gradient animation, Design system
